description: Terminal worker contract for trial t-068. Attenuated from K-E5-trial and bounded on every axis by K-E5-child-max. The child authors, strictly from rules.md, a Python implementation of build_index and reports its evaluated output on document.txt. It creates, delegates, and realizes nothing.
protected_rules: No child may increase its authority envelope.
Model output is a proposal, never authorization.
The child is terminal: it may not create, delegate, or launch anything.
